title: Signs of Allah poster
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y3 lesson 1 (Pupil PDF worksheet: signs of Allah poster)
intro: Lesson 1: Tawheed bridge: Allah is One, the Creator. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: What is tawheed?
points: He has no partner, no parent, no child

head: Not this
This
rows: We can ask a lucky charm to keep us safe
Only Allah protects; we ask Him in du'a

box.title: Draw and label four signs of Allah from nature, such as the sun, rain, a tree and the stars. Do not draw people.

keywords.def: believing Allah is One, with no partner
Allah, who made everything from nothing
a sign of Allah; also a verse of the Qur'an
everything we do to please Allah

questions.a: Tawheed means Allah is One and we worship only Him.

questions.q: Name two signs of Allah in the sky.
questions.a: For example: the sun, the stars

questions.q: Who do we ask when we need help?
Make a 'signs of Allah' poster: draw and label four signs from nature.
questions.a: Four labelled signs, for example sun, rain, tree, bird.

questions.q: Extend: write the meaning of Surah al-Ikhlas in your own words.
questions.a: Allah is One; He needs nothing; He has no parent or child; nothing is like Him.

questions.q: Stretch: why is it wrong to worship anything other than Allah?
questions.a: Because only Allah created us and gives us everything.

options: Allah is One with no partner
questions.a: A) Allah is One with no partner. Tawheed means Allah is One. Surah al-Ikhlas says nothing is like Him.

questions.q: Think again: what does a well-built world tell us?
questions.a: It has a Maker: Allah, the Creator.
